posts.author: Theponidraws
posts.body:
Recently, we decided to implement custom tilesets in our game to allow characters to walk behind objects. However, on a specific map, the tileset doesn’t seem to work correctly, causing certain parts of the sprite to become transparent when passing behind objects.
Here's a video with the problem
We've tried adjusting the position, resizing the tileset, and even separating the object into different parts, but the issue persists no matter what we do.
This is how it's programmed in game and the tileset sheet we're using
Does anyone know how to fix this? My theory is that the map’s grid is cutting off part of the sprite, making that section of the building appear incorrectly.
This is how it looks on the map editor

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
make the top part also a * so you have the top 2 in stars (above character).
an X means not passable, while O is, * is above character.
